data.summary: Landed via PR #72, merged as c9849d3. docs/joining.md repo-admin section gains a third one-time setting: the general dashboard-side-exclusion principle plus the verified Vercel Ignored Build Step example with the inverted-exit-codes gotcha and the system-env-vars prerequisite; Netlify/Cloudflare named only, no step-by-steps, no vercel.json route. tuhdoo init prints one new interpolated auto-deploys line (branchName(), not hardcoded); TestInitRemoteless asserts on it and no other test touches the init block. make test lint green; new copy matches the #71 register.
